plugin.name: Scripts & Executables
plugin.description: Run any script, executable or custom command as a run configuration and add it to Launch
opt.file.info: The script or executable to run, relative to the project root.
opt.args.info: Arguments passed to the script, separated by spaces; quote arguments that contain spaces.
opt.interpreter.info: Auto: executable files with a #! line run directly; files with #! use the interpreter it names; otherwise chosen by extension (.sh uses bash, .py prefers the project's virtual environment, .js uses node, and so on).
opt.cwd.script.info: Leave empty to run in the script's folder. Paths can be relative to the project root.
opt.cwd.command.info: Leave empty to run in the project root. Paths can be relative to the project root.
opt.command.info: Can span several lines, run in order as if typed into a terminal. Runs in your default shell, so shell syntax (pipes, &&, variables) works.
opt.shell.info: The shell that runs the command. Auto: your default shell on macOS/Linux, PowerShell on Windows.
err.noFile: The run configuration has no file to run
err.noCommand: The run configuration has no command
err.noInterpreter: Don't know how to run {0}: it isn't executable and the script type isn't recognized. Pick an interpreter in the run configuration.
diag.permission.title: No execute permission
diag.permission.message: The system refused to run this file directly. Give it execute permission, or run it with sh instead.
fix.chmod.confirm: Adds execute permission to this file (chmod +x). The file's contents don't change.
diag.noInterpreter.title: Interpreter {1} not found
diag.noInterpreter.message: {1}, named on the script's #! line, isn't on PATH. Install it, or pick another interpreter in the run configuration.
diag.commandNotFound.title: Command {1} not found
diag.commandNotFound.message: {1} isn't on PATH. Install it, or use its full path.
